docs.title: Welcome to the CherryHub
docs.text: I'm a mathematics student at the University of Leipzig and personal tutor. This is a website for showcasing computational projects and a place where I blog about mathematics for anyone interested in my work.

docs.title: Coding projects
docs.text:
I work on various projects involving programming. Mostly, I write in Python, but I also frequently write solutions in Julia. When new stuff is made, you can see it showcased here.

  • The CherryBot Discord App - Multi-purpose bot tool for Discord
  • Orbital - Julia Simulation of Planetary Orbits

docs.title: Math articles
docs.text:
I use this site to post blogs about mathematics. Coming soon, you might also find film theory here. Check out my article on the Calculus of Variations:

The Elegance of Variational Calculus, 5 min read

docs.title: Teaching resources
docs.text: This is still a work in progress! I'm planning to upload some study sheets and tutoring materials here. Stay up to date if you care about this.

docs.title: Who I am
docs.text:
My name is Cherry and I am a German mathematician and teacher. I specialize in developing solutions for computational problems and communicating higher academic mathematics. This website is my personal portfolio for projects I have made as well as a place to publish articles about interesting pieces of math. Feel free to read my work or just see the abstracts to know what it's about. If there's anything you'd like to talk about, feel free to hit me up. I'm always available to chat about my work or take suggestions / error reports.

In my free time, I enjoy reading poetry, solving Rubik's cubes, cycling, playing chess, analyzing films and making art.

This blog was originally started in September 2026. I cannot guarantee regular updates or publications.

docs.title: Setup
docs.text: Here are some basic steps on how to first get started with the bot. If anything ever doesn't work, you should probably check if you have everything done here. I generally recommend you to check the documentation if anything ever breaks. If this doesn't fix it, the root is something that most definitely but perchance occasionally possibly may have been my fault. Oops.

docs.title: Setting up an admin role
docs.text:
• this can only be done by the server owner
  • there can only be one role capable of cherrybot-privileges
  • please make sure only trusted members have this role
  • type %admin_add @[some_role]
  • type %adminrole to see the current admin role

docs.title: Setting up a welcome channel
docs.text:
• this assigns a specific channel from your server where a welcome message will be sent
  • this can only be done by someone with the local cherrybot admin role
  • use %welcome_add [mention-channel] to set a new channel or replacing the old one
  • use %welcome_remove to remove the local channel assignment
  • use %welcome_see to see your local channel assignment)

docs.title: The Elegance of Variational Calculus
docs.text: What's the fastest path between two points? How do physicists know how light travels? A practical introduction to optimizing functionals.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text: If you'd like to read this text, you should be fluent in single variable calculus. Without knowing what a derivative or integral is, you probably won't get far here. The main results are in form of differential equations.
